picks.name: claude-animated-shorts
picks.description: Free Claude skill: viral animated story shorts (2D characters in a 3D world) with three.js + Remotion
picks.readmeHead:
# Claude Animated Shorts

The free Claude skill from the video **"How to Make Viral Animated Shorts Using Claude (Full Workflow)"**.

It makes 55-70 s vertical animated story shorts: 2D characters in a colourful 3D world, with ink outlines, a painted town, lens blur, gliding cameras, a march score and sound effects. Everything is rendered with three.js inside Remotion on your own PC, with no AI video generator.

Proven on **The Bridge That Fell for a Song**, a 67 s short about the 1831 Broughton bridge.

## What's inside
| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | The skill: the full pipeline, every rule, every fix, and the final look values |
| `templates/bridge/` | The full source of the bridge short: world, characters, ink, lens blur, grade, story/camera |
| `templates/audio/` | The synthesized sound: SFX, march music, the mix with ducking and loudness |
| `templates/scripts/` | Stills, side-by-side sheets, shot merge and frame-by-frame QA helpers |
| `references/STYLE_BIBLE.md` | The script and visual formula measured from 20 reference shorts |
| `references/reports/` | Seven measured reports: motion, depth, textures, characters, lighting, outlines, grade |
| `references/frames/` | 38 full-size reference frames (540x960) to compare your frames against |
| `references/sheets/` | 20 contact sheets, one per reference short, 60 frames each (1,200 frames) |

## Install
1. Copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/cartoon-3d-short/` (clone it there, or download the ZIP).
2. You need [Remotion](https://www.remotion.dev/) with `@remotion/three`, plus Node, Python 3 and ffmpeg.
3. In Claude Code, say: *"Use the cartoon short skill and make a short about …"*.

Claude then follows `SKILL.md`: topic and facts, then script, then voice, then the shot plan in `story.ts`, then stills, then renders. Agents check your frames against the reports and the frames, and you get the final 2K render and sound mix.

picks.name: chimera-vocal-synth
picks.description: the ultimate vocal synthesizer - sing, speak, beatbox, and more
picks.readmeHead:
# CHIMERA

A physical-modeling voice synthesizer in the browser. Every sound comes from a simulated
airway (lungs, vocal folds or syrinx, a branched vocal tract, lips, nose), not from samples.
The engine is Rust, compiled to WebAssembly for an AudioWorklet; the same code runs natively
for tests and the `chimera` CLI.

## Vision & scope

1. **One instrument**: a physically modeled voice (lungs, vocal folds, throat, mouth). No
   samples, no neural audio.
2. **The web app is the primary surface**: anyone should be able to make songs in it without
   an LLM's help. Mobile is the likely next surface. The plugin (CLAP/VST3/AU) still ships, but
   it's secondary.
3. **As realistic as we can make it**: the main push is to see how close the simulation gets to
   a real voice. The robotic, Vocaloid-like sound people like today stays playable as a preset
   ([#93](https://github.com/jamesondh/chimera-vocal-synth/issues/93)).
4. **Languages enter through one shared front-end design**, not one-off hacks. Each needs a
   native speaker's check and must leave English unchanged.
5. **The design language (the vector display) is settled**; the look within it can still evolve.
6. **Nothing copyrighted in git**; MIT; a deterministic, real-time-safe engine.
7. **The 3D head can be worn by a body** ([docs/rig.md](docs/rig.md)), for the videos people
   make with the voice, posed by joint angles or moved by other tools' motion (Mixamo, BVH,
   glTF): a small library, not animation software (no timeline, no renderer).
8. **Not now**: a DAW or sequencer, a light theme, multi-voice dialogue, translating the
   interface (the voice speaks and sings many languages; the labels stay in English).

## What it does

- **Play**: drag the tongue, lips and jaw in a live cutaway of the head; vowel pad, encoders,
  computer keyboard and Web MIDI.
- **Speak**: English text (CMUdict with a letter-to-sound fallback), Turkish text (EN/TR) or
  IPA, turned into gestures and prosody, with the gestural score

picks.readmeHead:
# 拍片哥女装 · AI 服装参考图集 (COSTUME-DB-01)

一个深色主题的纯净服装参考图集网站，收录 **2727 套**（写实真人版 1407 套 + 二次元动漫版 1320 套）人物不入镜的 AI 生成纯服装图像（2:3 比例），支持中英文双语浏览、多维检索，并配备可选的 AI 一键换装试穿。

> 👗 **【Linux.do 3级常任理事专属彩蛋】**  
> 听说在 [LINUX DO](https://linux.do/) 社区只要升到 **3 级（常任理事）** 就可以解锁“看女装大佬”的保留节目？身为一名尊贵的 Linux.do 3 级老兵，逛了一圈发现坛里的女装资源还不够看，干脆亲手搓了这个 **「拍片哥女装」** 项目！  
> 不仅收录了写实与动漫双图库合计 2727 套纯净高质量服装图，还顺手接了 AI 虚拟换装后端——这下各位佬友哪怕现实中没有小裙子，直接传张自拍照就能一键无痛变身“女装大佬”出道了 😂！

> 🔗 **在线预览**：https://paipiange.github.io/nvzhuang/  
> ⭐ **GitHub 源码**：https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang  
> 📱 **Android APK 下载**：[GitHub Releases 直链](https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang/releases/latest/download/nvzhuang-release.apk)（[全部版本](https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang/releases)） | 也可[夸克网盘下载](https://pan.quark.cn/s/a914f76fac0b)（「拍片哥女装」`https://pan.quark.cn/s/a914f76fac0b`）  
> 👤 **AI 模特脸部与造型图库**：集成自 [ai-portrait-gallery](https://ai-portrait-gallery.pages.dev/)（あぎ @agi_aibusi · CC0 1.0）  
> 💃 **兄弟项目（AI 姿势参考与生图工坊）**：https://github.com/paipiange/ai-pose-gallery-zh  
> 💡 **原作者推文 / 灵感来源**：X [@giaaibusi](https://x.com/giaaibusi)  
> 🐧 **社区友链**：[LINUX DO (https://linux.do/)](https://linux.do/)

## ⏱️ 10 秒了解本项目

- 🆓 **免费使用（无需部署 / 无需 Key）**：三大图库一键无缝切换：**写实服装 (1407 套) + 动漫服装 (1320 套) + AI 模特库 (1499 位)**，支持分类筛选、中英双语双向检索、大图全屏查看、基础搭配台与同款跳转，由纯前端静态驱动，在线打开即可使用。
- 👤 **内置 1499 位 AI 模特（全量本地化）**：完整集成 CC0 1.0 授权的 AI 模特脸部特写与造型图库，AI 试衣时可直接一键挑选心仪模特，彻底告别“想体验换装却找不到合适人像照片”的困扰。
- ⚙️ **自选扩展（需自建后端 / 需自备 Key）**：真实 AI 试衣换装功能依赖 `backend/` 的 GoFrame 服务。需自行配置大模型（如 GPT Image 2、豆包 Seedream 或 Gemini）的 API Key 与 Base URL，调用将消耗对应的第三方模型配额。
- 💬 **AI 虚拟陪伴与角色工作室**：独立本机页面可浏览 AI 模特、服装图库，选择姿势并调用图像模型生成换装形象，还能用本机中文语音朗读聊天回复。支持自带聊天与生图模型 Key、FLClash 代理。启动方式、模型能力与隐私说明见 [`girlfriend/README.md`](girlfriend/README.md)。
- 📜 **完全可商用 · 免费开源**：基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 全量开源，代码与图集资源完全开放，支持自由商用创作、设计参考及二次开发。详见 [合规审计报告](docs/LINUXDO_RELEASE_AUDIT.md)。
